name: Wayward Cat
text: When you play this card, you need not follow suit on the next trick.

signature.target: your play to the next trick

archetypes: Discard Dominance, Nil Champion, Blind Bidder
decision: When to play it: just before a trick where following suit would force out a dangerous card on a nil, or where a discard would open a void.
opponent: Visible when played, so opponents see the relief a trick ahead; one surprise off-suit play a round.
aiNote: Play it as usual; on the relieved trick, if on nil, play your highest card that does not follow suit; otherwise play from your shortest non-spade suit.
rationale: One relieved trick a round, timed by when you play this card: a nil bidder sheds a dangerous card safely, and a discard deck gets a discard even without a void. The card itself follows the usual rules, so it is a timing tool rather than a wildcard (Faithful Dog, GR-C04).
deviation: Revision 1: replaced "You may play this card even if you could follow suit," which mostly repeated Faithful Dog (GR-C04).
